application.name: accordo
application.productionPosture: local development only: no authentication, tenancy or RBAC exists, and actor headers are not identity

limitations.message: the configured application database is never opened, so what a particular database has applied, holds or is missing is unknown
reading a code-first package means importing it, so package code runs with this process’s authority. Nothing here is sandboxed

the load runs in its own process group and a timeout stops that group, so an ordinary child a package spawns is stopped with it. A package that deliberately detaches a process into a new group outlives the inspection; tracking descendants is not attempted and would not be a sandbox either
JTBD and quality-gate status live in Markdown maintained by people; they are referenced by path and never parsed into structured claims
no CI, browser-smoke or benchmark result is read or inferred
no secret, credential, token or environment value is read, and no provider is contacted or authenticated
a registered provider definition says a provider was composed, never that it is reachable, configured or operational
there is no authentication, tenancy or RBAC in this framework, so no runtime authorization can be reported
the framework has no seam for a package to contribute an Admin extension, so adminExtensions is empty for every project — not merely empty for this one
source-only inspection can say which records exist, never whether their data is correct, complete or duplicated
nothing here reports what is running, deployed or reachable

evidence.note: these documents are prose maintained by people; AX1 references them and never parses them into structured claims
